The power of healing can be OP. While it can be used to heal people, it can also be manipulated to cause a lot of harm.
 1.Bloodstone - Franken-Castle #20
 During Dark Reign, Norman Osborn was the director of HAMMER, the replacement of SHIELD. He recruited villains to act as the new Avengers, which included Daken, Wolverine's son, to be his team's Wolverine.
 Frank Castle was a problem for Osborn, so he sent Daken to kill Frank, which Daken succeeded, cutting him up in bits and pieces. Later, however, Frank was ressurected as Franken-Castle using the Bloodstone, a magical stone that granted the user a healing factor.
